messages.content: "你能幫我計算三個不同三角形的總面積嗎？第一個三角形的底邊長為15公尺，高度為20公尺。第二個三角形的底邊長為25英呎，高度為30英呎。第三個三角形的底邊長為35英吋，高度為40英吋。我想要每個三角形的面積以它們各自的單位呈現。"

function.name: geometry_area_triangle
function.description: Calculate the area of a triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

base.description: The length of the base of the triangle.

height.description: The height of the triangle from the base.

unit.description: The measurement unit for the area. Defaults to square meters.

The user wants to calculate areas of three triangles with different units: first in meters, second in feet, third in inches. They want each area in its own unit. We need to use the tool geometry_area_triangle. But we have only one function that calculates area of a triangle given base, height, and optional unit. It returns "any". We can call it three times.

We should call the function for each triangle separately. The function signature expects base, height, unit? So we pass base=15, height=20, unit="square meters"? Actually the unit param is measurement unit for the area, defaults to square meters. For the first triangle, we can pass unit="square meters" or just omit because default is square meters. For second, unit="square feet". Third, unit="square inches".

We need to output the results. We'll call the function thrice. Use the tool calls. Then produce a response summarizing the areas.
